_comment: Who and what the self-hosted mac runner accepts. docs/plans/42_self_hosted_mac_runner_plan.md section 3.6. Two consumers: the controller streams this file into every job VM for the admission hook (hook_events, push_refs, actors), and github/apply-policy.sh writes the repository's workflow execution policy from it (policy_events, actors). IDs are what count; logins are notes, except that a re-run's triggering actor is only known by login.

candidates.note: Codex; move to actors when it opens PRs under its own identity
